thread:
Maria Gutierrez: Heads-up — customer AcmeApps says their GCP Accelerator credits never showed up in our billing/credits ledger. They were told grant was applied last week but their account still reads 0 credits and API usage is being billed. Customer email: jen@acme.com. Account: gcp-prod-2331. Screenshot link: https://files.redwood/acme/gcp-credits.png

Samir Patel: Can you paste the marketplace order ID and the grant/entitlement id from the partner portal? Also which project they used when trying to redeem?

Maria Gutierrez: Order ID: MARKET-987654. Partner grant id (from our partner UI): GRANT-0xA1B2C3. Customer says they used project id: acme-prod-2331. They've tried signing out/signing in. It's been 10 days.

Akash Rao: Usually GCP Marketplace grants propagate within 24-72h but can hang if the Marketplace account is linked to a different billing account or there's a duplicate entitlement. Can you confirm the GCP Billing Account ID they have attached to the project? Also send us the marketplace subscription id (if different from MARKET-987654).

Maria Gutierrez: Customer responded: billing account id = 012345-678901-ABCDEF. Marketplace subscription id shown in their console: 9876543210. They say both match what they provided to the accelerator partner.

Lee Huang: I'll check partner-side mapping. Two quick repro checks for you while I look: 1) Confirm project-level BillingInfo via Cloud Billing API; 2) Confirm the Marketplace entitlement attached to the project via Google Cloud console -> Marketplace -> Subscriptions. Sample curl to check billing info:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://cloudbilling.googleapis.com/v1/projects/acme-prod-2331/billingInfo"
```

Maria Gutierrez: Running that now for them — paste below when you have results.

deploy-bot: rdw-job-4456: queued "marketplace-entitlement-sync" for order MARKET-987654 by Maria Gutierrez.

Samir Patel: If the entitlement exists on GCP but our internal ledger didn't link it, try running the internal sync tool with force for that order:
```
rdw-infra sync-marketplace --platform gcp --order MARKET-987654 --force --verbose
```

Maria Gutierrez: Ran the sync tool (returned exit 0) and the job processed — deploy-bot shows finish: rdw-job-4456 completed with warnings: "duplicate external_account -> mapping conflict". Log snippet: "found entitlement 0xA1B2C3 attached to ext_account 54321 but our ledger mapped to ext_account 98765"

Samir Patel: That's the issue — duplicate external account mapping. Looks like the partner created a new marketplace account for the same customer and the grant landed on the other external account (54321) which isn't linked to acme-prod-2331 in our DB. Lee, can you confirm which external account Marketplace reported?

Lee Huang: Confirmed via partner portal: grant GRANT-0xA1B2C3 is attached to external_account 54321 (partner-level id). Customer's project is linked to external_account 98765. We need to remap 54321 -> 98765 in our entitlement service or ask partner ops to reassign the grant.

Akash Rao: I can do a manual credit adjustment to avoid customer downtime. I'll create an internal billing adjustment for AcmeApps for the billed usage while we fix the mapping. Please capture the exact usage window to refund.

Maria Gutierrez: Noted. I'll ask the customer for the exact timestamps of the billed calls and open a support ticket for adjustment. Also flagging Partner Ops to reassign.

Lee Huang: Partner Ops confirmed they'll reassign GRANT-0xA1B2C3 to external_account 98765 and it should surface in our ledger in ~2 hours after we trigger another sync. I'll kick the sync once they finish.

deploy-bot: rdw-job-4471: manual-ledger-adjustment queued by Akash Rao.

Akash Rao: Adjustment queued and will post once processed. ETA ~30m. I'll follow up here with transaction id.

Maria Gutierrez: Thanks team. Maria -> Customer: "Jen: we found a duplicate marketplace account mapping; we've queued a manual credit adjustment and partner ops will reassign the grant. Expect credits to appear within ~2 hours and the refund for billed calls within ~30m-1h. I'll update you when both are done." :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: Follow-up: we'll add a check in our marketplace onboarding to detect duplicated external_account ids and auto-alert partner ops to prevent this. Filing a follow-up GH issue after this thread.

Maria Gutierrez: Closing internal thread when both ledger update + billing adjustment are confirmed. Will post final resolution here. Thanks everyone.
